title: 市场担忧AI支出见顶：台积电Q2净利润却超预期，毛利率67.7%能否持续
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Stephen, you have seen the numbers now. Give us your takeaways. Yeah, I mean, there were already pretty lofty expectations for these results.
segments.zh: Stephen，你已经看到数据了。说说你的看法。嗯，市场对这些业绩已有很高预期。

segments.en: What people were looking for is whether they did not meet those expectations.
segments.zh: 大家关注的是能否达标。

segments.en: They've done the opposite. They've surpassed it handedly.
segments.zh: 结果不仅达标，还大幅超出。

segments.en: We're seeing net income of $706.56 billion new Taiwan dollars.
If you don't know the math and the equation for the conversion, that's $22 billion US dollars.
The expectations was for about 19.4 billion.
So it's a significant beat, I should say.
Actually, revenue was much higher as well.
Basically, reaffirming that 36% increase in revenue, in those numbers that we got a couple of days ago, in the second quarter.
segments.zh: 这基本确认了第二季度营收增长36%的数据。

segments.en: We're also seeing gross margins outperforming. Gross margins for the quarter was 67.7% operating margins at 60.3% net profit margins
segments.zh: 毛利率也表现优异：季度毛利率67.7%，营业利润率60.3%，净利润率也很高。

segments.en: at over 55 and a half percent. Again, we were looking at these numbers quite closely
segments.zh: 超过55.5%。我们仔细审视这些数字

segments.en: to see of any signs of the AI spending build out was coming to a head or was coming to a hall
segments.zh: 寻找AI支出建设是否见顶或放缓的迹象

segments.en: and was going to cast a further poll on these semiconductor stocks that we've seen of late.
segments.zh: 以及是否会给近期半导体股带来进一步压力
